reason: I want to take the last greens before putting the garden away; scissors seem suited to harvesting the nursery.
expectation: I expect to cut some lettuce for the final harvest, though I don't know whether it needs washing next.

alternatives.reason: Storing seed potatoes also serves the goal, but I want to harvest first.

effect: The harvest produced leaves, so I can prepare them before putting the equipment away.
reason: Rinsing the harvested leaves seems like the next practical step before taking them.
expectation: I expect washed leaves ready to keep or eat.

effect: The greens are washed; I can turn to leaving the station ready.
reason: The cool locker seems a natural place to keep the seed potatoes for the next surveyor.
expectation: I expect the seed potatoes to be stored cool for later planting.

alternatives.reason: The water line also needs attention, but I want to finish the seed goal first.

effect: The seed and greens goal is complete, leaving water and equipment to secure.
reaction: A small satisfaction in preserving the potato stock for someone else.
reason: The tool should let me shut down or drain the water line for storage.
expectation: I expect the covered line to be made safe for an unattended period, perhaps by draining it.

alternatives.reason: Cleaning the lettuce trough also fits the remaining goal, but the line seems a good place to start.

effect: The line action winterized the plant, though I don't know exactly what the tool did.
reaction: The outcome makes sense but feels a little abrupt at the scale of the whole plant.
reason: Water should rinse the used lettuce trough before it is stored.
expectation: I expect a rinsed trough, perhaps needing further cleaning or storage.

alternatives.reason: The other trough is already clean and could be racked now; I want to prepare this one too.

effect: The lettuce trough is cleared and can now be placed on the rack.
reaction: The clearing is straightforward; I'm unsure whether cleared also means clean.
reason: Putting the cleared trough on the equipment rack follows the storage goal.
expectation: I expect the cleared lettuce trough to be stored on the rack.

alternatives.reason: The refill trough also belongs on the rack, but I just prepared the lettuce trough.

effect: The lettuce trough is on the rack; the other trough remains to be stored.
reason: The refill trough is already clean, and this is the only gameplay action offered.
expectation: I expect it to join the lettuce trough on the rack and complete storage.

effect: Both troughs are stored and the chapter's remaining goal is complete.
reaction: A quiet, orderly ending; I would have liked a little more sense of the place being left behind.

mostWorthwhile.text: Protecting the seed potatoes felt worthwhile because it leaves something living for the next surveyor, connecting the harvest to a future use.

leastWorthwhile.text: Washing the leaves and placing the two troughs were sensible but predictable, with little new to discover in their results.

surprise.text: The tool acting on a covered water line produced a winterized water plant; the broad result was more than I expected from the named pair, and I could not tell what had been done.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, but using water on the lettuce trough produced a 'cleared' trough without explaining whether it was cleaned for storage.

continue.text: Yes, chiefly to see what happens to the remarkable body in the ice and the return journey; this chapter's practical closure was pleasant but offered few challenging choices or discoveries itself.
